title: Minimal Brand Logos in MJ: A Practical Guide
description: How to use MJ v6.1 for minimal logo / brand symbol design (symbols work better than text combos).

prompt.main: minimalist geometric logo design of a mountain peak inside a circle, vector graphic style, monochromatic black on white, clean lines, scalable from favicon to billboard, professional brand identity, bauhaus inspired, no text

explained.why: v6.1 logo style is cleaner than v5.
MJ often misspells text. Explicitly say "no text" to avoid the issue.

tutorial.intro: MJ works well for symbol/icon logos. For "text + symbol" combos, use Ideogram 2.0 instead.
steps: Purpose: minimalist geometric logo design 鈥?use case + style.
Subject: mountain peak inside a circle 鈥?simple subject + container.
Style: vector graphic style, bauhaus inspired 鈥?vector + design movement.
Palette: monochromatic black on white 鈥?lock to one color.
Explicit no: no text 鈥?sidesteps MJ's text mistakes.
Scalability: scalable from favicon to billboard 鈥?emphasize logo scalability.
tutorial.tips: MJ is best for "explore the vibe" on logos. Production logos still need Figma cleanup. 100% drop-in AI logos are rare.

crossModel.stable_diffusion: SDXL + any model works; add "vector, logo, simple, minimal" to the prompt.

faq.a: Check ToS. MJ standard subscription allows commercial use, Pro gives you higher commercial rights.
